title: Inquest: Log-Guided Root-Cause Code Localization with a Staged Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.19554v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a production issue is reported, engineers get a description and some logs, but no failing test and no way to reproduce the fault. The logs show where the failure was noticed, not where it was caused: in 49% of the real reports we study, the text names none of the files that the fix later changed. We built a benchmark for this setting from two public datasets and 27 open-source projects (Apache, Red Hat, MongoDB, MariaDB, Qt and Sakai). It holds 38,001 resolved issue reports with their pasted logs, the code as it was while the bug was still present, and the files the fix changed. We present INQUEST, an agent that finds the faulty code using a 27B open-weights model. Code, not the model, controls the procedure. It first gathers the evidence, including the files fixed in similar past issues that were resolved before the report was filed. The model then makes only three bounded decisions: which files to open, what role each file plays

translated_title: Inquest：基于分阶段智能体的日志引导根因代码定位
translated_abstract: 当生产环境问题被报告时，工程师只能获得一段描述和一些日志，既没有失败的测试用例，也无法复现故障。日志显示的是故障被发现的位置，而非故障产生的原因：在我们研究的真实报告中，49%的报告文本并未提及修复最终修改的任何文件。我们从两个公开数据集和27个开源项目（Apache、Red Hat、MongoDB、MariaDB、Qt和Sakai）为这一场景构建了一个基准，其中包含38,001份已解决的issue报告及其附带日志、bug仍存在时的代码状态，以及修复所修改的文件。我们提出了INQUEST，一个使用27B开源权重模型查找故障代码的智能体。流程由代码而非模型控制：它首先收集证据，包括在报告提交之前就已解决的类似历史issue中修复的文件；随后模型只需做出三个受限决策——打开哪些文件、每个文件扮演什么角色……
tldr: 提出INQUEST，一个使用27B开源模型的分阶段智能体，通过日志与相似历史issue等证据自动定位生产故障的根因代码，并基于38,001份真实issue报告构建了新基准。
en_tdlr: Inquest is a staged agent powered by a 27B open-weights model that localizes root-cause code from production logs and evidence, evaluated on a new benchmark of 38,001 real resolved issue reports.
